# UW Digital Collections (UWDC)

> > Digital collections portal for UW-Madison Libraries providing access to digitized special collections, archives, and scholarly resources including language dictionaries, historical documents, and university materials.

The University of Wisconsin Digital Collections (UWDC) serves as the primary search interface for exploring digitized materials from UW-Madison Libraries, including specialized collections like the Icelandic Online Dictionary and Readings, Survey Notes, Harold Scheub Collection, and Health Advertisements Database (HADES). These collections support research, teaching, and learning across humanities, social sciences, health sciences, and area studies.

## Main Search Interface

- [UWDC Search - UW-Madison Libraries](https://digicoll.library.wisc.edu/): Homepage for UW-Madison Libraries digital collections search interface

## Optional

- [While searching in Icelandic Online Dictionary and Readings](https://digicoll.library.wisc.edu/cgi-bin/IcelOnline/IcelOnline.TEId-idx): Search error page for Icelandic Online Dictionary and Readings
- [Error while searching in Survey Notes](https://digicoll.library.wisc.edu/cgi-bin/SurveyNotes/SurveyNotes-idx): Search error page for Survey Notes collection from BCPL
